<div class="card-body">
'''Noble Sacrifice''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">尊い犠牲</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターを配備した直後に、場に出ている、同じ戦闘力を持つ自分のキャラクター（捕らえられた者でも可）を一人、犠牲（除外カードにする）にする。犠牲にしたキャラクターの没収値に等しい枚数だけ、ロストデッキからフォースを再使用できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-99o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ダース、貴様はわしに勝てぬ。ここで敗れても、お前の想像よりはるかに力強き存在となるのだ。」オビ＝ワンの犠牲により、反乱軍は逃げ出す時間を稼ぐことができた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Noble Sacrifice.

'''Card text:''' Just after the opponent deploys a character, sacrifice (place out of play) one of your characters on table with the same power (even a captive). Retrieve Force from the Lost Pile equal to that character's forfeit.

'''Lore:''' “You can't win, Darth. If you strike me down, I shall become more powerful than you can imagine.” Obi-Wan's sacrifice bought the Rebellion time to escape.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Noble Sacrifice]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
